verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global-employment HR SaaS that handles sensitive employee data, so data residency is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or data residency. Its references to 120+/180+ countries describe where it can employ people, not where data is stored, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
